mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name, o.customer_name, o.receive_address, o.expect_ship_time, o.status, o.reverse_of_id, o.reversed_by_id, o.total_qty, o.allocated_qty, o.picked_qty, o.allocate_time, o.remark, o.create_time, o.update_time FROM outbound_order o LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = o.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = 0 WHERE o.id = #{id} AND o.deleted = 0
mapper.update: INSERT INTO outbound_order (order_no, warehouse_id, customer_id, customer_name, receive_address, expect_ship_time, status, reverse_of_id, total_qty, allocated_qty, picked_qty, allocate_time, remark, deleted, create_by) SELECT #{newOrderNo}, warehouse_id, customer_id, customer_name, receive_address, expect_ship_time, 'SHIPPED', id, total_qty, total_qty, total_qty, NOW(3), CONCAT('红冲自 ', order_no), 0, #{createBy} FROM outbound_order WHERE id = #{originalId} AND deleted = 0

INSERT INTO outbound_order_item (order_id, sku_id, sku_code, sku_name, qty, allocated_qty, picked_qty, remark, deleted, create_by) SELECT #{newOrderId}, sku_id, sku_code, sku_name, qty, qty, qty, remark, 0, create_by FROM outbound_order_item WHERE order_id = #{originalId} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE outbound_order SET status = 'REVERSED', reversed_by_id = #{reversedById}, update_by = #{updateBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'SHIPPED' AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, warehouse_id, customer_name, receive_address, expect_ship_time, status, reverse_of_id, reversed_by_id, total_qty, allocated_qty, picked_qty, allocate_time, remark, deleted, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by FROM outbound_order WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE outbound_order SET status = 'ALLOCATED', allocated_qty = #{allocatedQty}, allocate_time = NOW(3), update_by = #{updateBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'CREATED' AND deleted = 0
UPDATE outbound_order SET status = 'PICKED', picked_qty = #{pickedQty}, update_by = #{updateBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PICKING' AND deleted = 0
UPDATE outbound_order SET status = 'CREATED', allocated_qty = 0, allocate_time = NULL, update_by = #{updateBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ALLOCATED' AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_task WHERE source_type = 'OUTBOUND_ORDER' AND source_id = #{orderId} AND task_type = 'PICK' AND deleted = 0 AND status NOT IN ('DONE', 'CANCELLED')
SELECT id FROM outbound_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'ALLOCATED' AND allocate_time IS NOT NULL AND allocate_time < #{deadline} ORDER BY allocate_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
